facts: Until 14:00 local, one queue was applied in all regions.
Western/southern group: 14:00-16:00 one queue; 16:00-19:00 two queues; 19:00-24:00 three queues.
Kyiv/eastern-central group: 14:00-16:00 two queues; 16:00-24:00 three queues.
publisher: UNN and Suspilne, citing NPC Ukrenergo
research_use: Auxiliary L2 regional dose-response/sensitivity episode, not a clean confirmatory validation; exclude regions affected by 20 July attack in sensitivity.
title: Ukrenergo updated 23 July outage schedules with regional queue intensity
